description: This file defines an enumeration 'InterestIncentiveAttributeName' used for representing different interest incentive attribute types within the 'interest rate chart incentive' component of the project. It includes methods for mapping integer codes to enum values, checking attribute types, and retrieving associated properties like code and value.

classes.name: InterestIncentiveAttributeName
classes.description: An enumeration representing different attribute names used for interest incentives, such as gender, age, client type, and classification.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Returns the enum constant corresponding to the provided integer value, defaulting to INVALID if none match.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the enum, replacing underscores with spaces.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the integer code associated with the enum constant.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Retrieves the string code associated with the enum constant.

methods.name: isGender
methods.description: Checks if the enum instance represents the gender attribute.

methods.name: isAge
methods.description: Checks if the enum instance represents the age attribute.

methods.name: isClientType
methods.description: Checks if the enum instance represents the client type attribute.

methods.name: isClientClassification
methods.description: Checks if the enum instance represents the client classification attribute.

methods.name: isInvalid
methods.description: Checks if the enum instance represents an invalid attribute.

methods.name: isCodeValueAttribute
methods.description: Determines if the given attribute name is one that uses specific codes (gender, client type, client classification).

methods.name: integerValues
methods.description: Returns an array of integer codes for all valid attribute names excluding INVALID.
